1.1: Kol hazzevachim shenizbechu shello lishman, kesherim, ella shello alu labbealim leshem chova. chutz min happesach umin hachattat. happesach bizmanno, vehachattat, bechol zeman. rabbi eliezer omer, af haasham. happesach bizmanno, vehachattat vehaasham, bechol zeman. amar rabbi eliezer, hachattat baa al chet, vehaasham ba al chet. ma chattat pesula shello lishmah, af haasham pasul shello lishmo:
1.2: Yose ven choni omer, hannishchatim leshem pesach uleshem chattat, pesulim. shimon achi azarya omer, shechatan leshem gavoah mehem, kesherin. leshem namuch mehem, pesulim. ketzad. kadshe kadashim sheshshechatan leshem kadashim kallim, pesulin. kadashim kallim sheshshechatan leshem kadshe kadashim, kesherin. habbechor vehammaaser sheshshechatan leshem shelamim, kesherin. ushelamim sheshshechatan leshem bechor, leshem maaser, pesulin:
1.3: Happesach sheshshechato veshacharit bearbaa asar shello lishmo, rabbi yehoshua machshir, keillu nishchat bishlosha asar. ben betera posel, keillu nishchat ben haarbayim. amar shimon ben azzay, mekubbal ani mippi shivim ushenayim zaken, beyom shehoshivu rabbi elazar ben azarya vayshiva, shekkol hazzevachim hanneechalim shennizbechu shello lishman, kesherim, ella shello alu labbealim mishshum chova, chutz min happesach umin hachattat. velo hosif ben azzay ella haola, velo hodu lo chachamim:
1.4: Happesach vehachattat sheshshechatan shello lishman, kibbel, vehillech, vezarak, shello lishman, o lishman veshello lishman, o shello lishman velishman, pesulim. ketzad lishman veshello lishman, leshem pesach uleshem shelamim. shello lishman velishman, leshem shelamim uleshem happesach. shehazzevach nifsal bearbaa devarim, bashshechita uvakkibbul uvahilluch uvazzerika. rabbi shimon machshir behilluch, shehaya rabbi shimon omer, i efshar shello vishchita veshello vekabbala veshello vizrika, aval efshar shello vehilluch, shochet betzad hammizbeach vezorek. rabbi eliezer omer, hamehallech bimkom shehu tzarich lehallech, hammachashava foselet. uvimkom sheen tzarich lehallech, en hammachashava fosalet:

2.1: Kol hazzevachim shekkibbel daman zar, onen, tevul yom, mechussar begadim, mechussar kippurim, shello rechutz yadayim veraglayim, arel, tame, yoshev, omed al gabbe chelim, al gabbe vehema, al gabbe ragle chavero, pasal. kibbel bassemol, pasal. rabbi shimon machshir. nishpach haddam al haritzpa vaasafo, pasul. netano al gabbe hakkevesh shello cheneged hayesod, natan et hannittanin lemattan, lemalan, veet hannittanin lemalan, lemattan, et hannittanim bifnim, bachutz, veet hannittanin bachutz, bifnim, pasul veen bo charet:
2.2: Hashshochet et hazzevach lizrok damo vachutz o miktzat damo vachutz, lehaketir et emurav bachutz o miktzat emurav bachutz, leechol besaro vachutz o chazzayit mibbesaro vachutz o leechol kazzayit meor haalya vachutz, pasul veen bo charet. lizrok damo lemachar o miktzat damo lemachar, lehaketir emurav lemachar o miktzat emurav lemachar, leechol besaro lemachar o chazzayit mibbesaro lemachar o kazzayit meor haalya lemachar, piggul vechayyavin alav karet:
2.3: Ze hakkelal, kol hashshochet vehamekabbel vehamehallech vehazzorek, leechol davar sheddarko leechol, lehaketir davar sheddarko lehaketir, chutz limkomo, pasul veen bo charet. chutz lizmanno, piggul vechayyavin alav karet, uvilvad sheyyikrav hammattir kemitzvato:
2.4: Ketzad karav hammattir kemitzvato. shachat bishtika, kibbel vehillech vezarak chutz lizmanno. o sheshshachat chutz lizmanno, kibbel vehillech vezarak bishtika. o sheshshachat, vekibbel vehillech vezarak chutz lizmanno, ze hu shekkarav hammattir kemitzvato. ketzad lo karav hammattir kemitzvato. shachat chutz limkomo, kibbel vehillech vezarak chutz lizmanno. o sheshshachat chutz lizmanno, kibbel vehillech vezarak chutz limkomo. o sheshshachat, kibbel, vehillech, vezarak, chutz limkomo. happesach vehachattat sheshshechatan shello lishman, kibbel vehillech vezarak chutz lizmanno. o sheshshachat chutz lizmanno, kibbel vehillech vezarak shello lishman. o sheshshachat, kibbel, vehillech, vezarak, shello lishman. ze hu shello karav hammattir kemitzvato:
2.5: Leechol kazzayit bachutz vechazzayit lemachar, kazzayit lemachar vechazzayit bachutz, kachatzi zayit bachutz vechachatzi zayit lemachar, kachatzi zayit lemachar vechachatzi zayit bachutz, pasul veen bo charet. amar rabbi yehuda, ze hakkelal, im machashevet hazzeman kadma lemachashevet hammakom, piggul vechayyavim alav karet. veim machashevet hammakom kadma lemachashevet hazzeman, pasul veen bo charet. vachachamim omrim ze vaze fasul veen bo charet. leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit, kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin:

3.1: Kol happesulin sheshshachatu, shechitatan keshera. shehashshechita cheshera bezarim, benashim, uvaavadim, uvitmeim, afillu vekadshe kadashim, uvilvad shello yihyu temeim nogim babbasar. lefichach hem poslim bemachashava. vechullan shekkibbelu et haddam chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, im yesh dam hannefesh, yachazor hakkasher vikabbel:
3.2: Kibbel hakkasher venatan lappasul, yachazir lakkasher. kibbel bimino venatan lismolo, yachazir limino. kibbel bichli kodesh venatan bichli chol, yachazir lichli kodesh. nishpach min hakkeli al haritzpa vaasafo, kasher. netano al gabbe hakkevesh, shello cheneged hayesod, natan et hannittanin lematta, lemala, veet hannittanim lemala, lematta, et hannittanim bifnim, bachutz, veet hannittanim bachutz, bifnim, im yesh dam hannefesh, yachazor hakkasher vikabbel:
3.3: Hashshochet et hazzevach leechol davar sheen darko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheen darko lehaketir, kasher. rabbi eliezer posel. leechol davar sheddarko leechol ulehaktir davar sheddarko lehaketir, pachot mikkazzayit, kasher. leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit, kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin:
3.4: Hashshochet et hazzevach leechol kazzayit min haor, min harotev, min hakkifa, min haalal, min haatzamot, min haggidim, min hattelafayim, min hakkarnayim, chutz lizmanno o chutz limkomo, kasher, veen chayyavim alehem mishshum piggul venotar vetame:
3.5: Hashshochet et hammukdashin leechol shalil o shilya vachutz, lo figgel. hammolek torin bifnim leechol betzehem bachutz, lo figgel. chalev hammukdashin uvetze torin, en chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame:
3.6: Shechato al menat lehanniach damo o et emurav lemachar, o lehotzian lachutz, rabbi yehuda fosel, vachachamim machshirin. shechato al menat litteno al gabbe hakkevesh shello cheneged hayesod, litten et hannittanin lematta, lemala, veet hannittanin lemala, lematta, et hannittanin bifnim, bachutz, veet hannittanin bachutz, bifnim, sheyyochluhu temeim, sheyyakrivuhu temeim, sheyyochluhu arelim, sheyyakrivuhu arelim, leshabber atzmot happesach veleechol hemennu na, learev damo vedam pesulin, kasher, sheen hammachashava foselet ella chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, vehappesach vehachattat shello lishman:

4.1: Bet shammay omrim, kol hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon, sheim netanan mattana achat, kipper. uvechattat, shete mattanot. uvet hillel omrim, af chattat shennetanah mattana achat, kipper. lefichach, im natan et harishona chetiknah veet hashsheniyya chutz lizmannah, kipper. natan et harishona chutz lizmannah veet hashsheniyya chutz limkomah, piggul, vechayyavin alav karet:
4.2: Kol hannittanin al mizbeach happenimi, sheim chissar achat min hammattanot, lo chipper. lefichach, im natan kullan ketiknan veachat shello chetiknah, pasul, veen bo charet:
4.3: Ellu devarim sheen chayyavin alehem mishshum piggul. hakkometz, vehallevona, vehakketoret, uminchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, (uminchat nesachim), vehaddam, vehannesachim habbaim bifne atzman, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, af habbaim im habbehema. log shemen shel metzora, rabbi shimon omer, en chayyavin alav mishshum piggul. verabbi meir omer, chayyavin alav mishshum piggul, sheddam haasham mattiro. vechol sheyyesh lo mattirim ben laadam ben lammizbeach, chayyavin alav mishshum piggul:
4.4: Haola, damah mattir et besarah lammizbeach veorah lakkohanim. olat haof, damah mattir et besarah lammizbeach. chattat haof, damah mattir et besarah lakkohanim. parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim, daman mattir et emurehen likkarev. rabbi shimon omer, kol sheeno al mizbeach hachitzon kishlamim, en chayyavin alav mishshum piggul:
4.5: Kadshe nachrim, en chayyavin alehem mishshum piggul, notar vetame. vehashshochatan bachutz, patur, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose mechayyev. devarim sheen chayyavin alehem mishshum piggul, chayyavim alehem mishshum notar, mishshum tame, chutz min haddam. rabbi shimon omer, bedavar sheddarkan leheachel. aval kegon haetzim vehallevona vehakketoret, en chayyavin alehem mishshum tuma:
4.6: Leshem shishsha devarim hazzevach nizbach, leshem zevach, leshem zoveach, leshem hashshem, leshem ishshim, leshem reach, leshem nichoach. vehachattat vehaasham, leshem chet. amar rabbi yose, af mi shello haya velibbo leshem achad mikkol ellu, kasher, shehu tenay bet din, sheen hammachashava holechet ella achar haoved:

5.1: Ezehu mekoman shel zevachim, kadshe kadashim shechitatan batztzafon, par vesair shel yom hakkippurim shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon, vedaman taun hazzaya al ben habbaddim veal happarochet veal mizbach hazzahav. mattana achat mehen meakkavet. sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon. im lo natan, lo ikkev:
5.2: Parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon, vedaman taun hazzaya al happarochet veal mizbach hazzahav. mattana achat mehen meakkavet. sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon. im lo natan, lo ikkev. ellu vaellu nisrafin bevet haddashen:
5.3: Chattovt hatztzibbur vehayyachid. ellu hen chattovt hatztzibbur, seire rashe chodashim veshel moadot, shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon, vedaman taun arba mattanot al arba keranot. ketzad. ala vakkevesh ufana lassovev, uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit, mizrachit tzefonit, tzefonit maaravit, maaravit deromit. sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod deromi. veneechalin lifnim min hakkelaim lezichre chehunna bechol maachol leyom valayla ad chatzot:
5.4: Haola, kadshe kadashim, shechitatah batztzafon, vekibbul damah bichli sharet batztzafon, vedamah taun shete mattanot shehen arba, uteuna hefshet venittuach vechalil laishshim:
5.5: Zivche shalme tzibbur vaashamot. ellu hen ashamot, asham gezelot, asham meilot, asham shifcha charufa, asham nazir, asham metzora, asham taluy, shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon, vedaman taun shete mattanot shehen arba, veneechalin lifnim min hakkelaim lezichre chehunna bechol maachol leyom valayla ad chatzot:
5.6: Hattoda veel nazir, kadashim kallim, shechitatan bechol makom baazara, vedaman taun shete mattanot shehen arba, veneechalim bechol hair lechol adam, bechol maachol, leyom valayla ad chatzot. hammuram mehem kayyotze vahem, ella shehammuram neechol lakkohanim, linshehem velivnehem uleavdehem:
5.7: Shelamim, kadashim kallim, shechitatan bechol makom baazara, vedaman taun shete mattanot shehen arba, veneechalin bechol hair lechol adam, bechol maachol, lishne yamim velayla echad. hammuram mehem kayyotze vahen, ella shehammuram neechol lakkohanim, linshehem velivnehem uleavdehem:
5.8: Habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach, kadashim kallim, shechitatan bechol makom baazara, vedaman taun mattana achat, uvilvad sheyyitten keneged hayesod. shinna vaachilatan, habbechor neechol lakkohanim, vehammaaser lechol adam, veneechalin bechol hair, lechol adam, bechol maachol, lishne yamim velayla echad. happesach eno neechol ella vallayla, veeno neechol ella ad chatzot, veeno neechol ella limnuyav, veeno neechol ella tzali:

6.1: Kadshe kadashim sheshshechatan berosh hammizbeach, rabbi yose omer, keillu nishchatu vatztzafon. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer, mechatzi hammizbeach velatztzafon, katztzafon. mechatzi hammizbeach veladdarom, kaddarom. hammenachot hayu nikmatzot bechol makom baazara, veneechalin lifnim min hakkelaim lezichre chehunna, bechol maachol, leyom valayla ad chatzot:
6.2: Chattat haof hayta naaset al keren deromit maaravit. bechol makom hayta cheshera, ella ze haya mekomah. ushelosha devarim hayta otah hakkeren meshammeshet millemattan, ushelosha milmalan. millemattan, chattat haof vehahaggashot usheyare haddam. milmalan, nissuch hammayim vehayyayin veolat haof keshehi rabba vammizrach:
6.3: Kol haolim lammizbeach, olin derech yamin, umakkifin veyordin derech semol, chutz min haole lishlosha devarim ellu, shehayu olim vechozrim leakev:
6.4: Chattat haof ketzad hayta naaset. haya molek et roshah mimmul arpah veeno mavdil, umazze middamah al kir hammizbeach. sheyare haddam, haya mitmatztze al hayesod. en lammizbeach ella damah, vechullah lakkohanim:
6.5: Olat haof ketzad hayta naaset. ala vakkevesh ufana lassovev, ba lo lekeren deromit mizrachit, haya molek et roshah mimmul arpah umavdil, umematztze et damah al kir hammizbeach. natal et harosh, vehikkif bet melikato lammizbeach, usefago vemelach, uzerako al gabbe haishshim, ba lo lagguf vehesir et hammura veet hannotza veet bene meayim hayyotzim immah, vehishlichan levet haddashen. shissa velo hivdil. veim hivdil, kasher. usefago vemelach, uzerako al gabbe haishshim:
6.6: Lo hesir lo et hammura velo et hannotza velo et bene meayim hayyotzin immah velo sefago vemelach, kol sheshshinna vah meachar shemmitztza et damah, keshera. hivdil bachattat velo hivdil baola, pasal. mitztza dam harosh velo mitztza dam hagguf, pesula. mitztza dam hagguf velo mitztza dam harosh, keshera:
6.7: Chattat haof shemmelakah shello lishmah, mitztza damah shello lishmah, o lishmah veshello lishmah, o shello lishmah velishmah, pesula. olat haof, keshera, uvilvad shello alta labbealim. echad chattat haof veechad olat haof shemmelakan veshemmitztza daman leechol davar sheddarko leechol, lehaketir davar sheddarko lehaketir, chutz limkomo, pasul, veen bo charet. chutz lizmanno, piggul, vechayyavin alav karet, uvilvad sheyyikrav hammattir kemitzvato. ketzad karav hammattir kemitzvato. malak bishtika umitztza haddam chutz lizmanno, o shemmalak chutz lizmanno umitztza haddam bishtika, o shemmalak umitztza haddam chutz lizmanno, ze hu shekkarav hammattir kemitzvato. ketzad lo karav hammattir kemitzvato. malak chutz limkomo umitztza haddam chutz lizmanno, o shemalak chutz lizmanno umitztza haddam chutz limkomo, o shemmalak umitztza haddam chutz limkomo, chattat haof shemmelakah shello lishmah umitztza damah chutz lizmannah, o shemmelakah chutz lizmannah umitztza damah shello lishmah, o shemmelakah umitztza damah shello lishmah, ze hu shello karav hammattir kemitzvato. leechol kazzayit bachutz vechazzayit lemachar, kazzayit lemachar vechazzayit bachutz, kachatzi zayit bachutz vechachatzi zayit lemachar, kachatzi zayit lemachar vechachatzi zayit bachutz, pasul, veen bo charet. amar rabbi yehuda, ze hakkelal, im machashevet hazzeman kadma lemachashevet hammakom, piggul, vechayyavin alav karet. veim machashevet hammakom kadma lemachashevet hazzeman, pasul, veen bo charet. vachachamim omrim, ze vaze fasul, veen bo charet. leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit, kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin:

7.1: Chattat haof sheasaah lematta, kemaase chattat leshem chattat, keshera. kemaase chattat leshem ola, kemaase ola leshem chattat, kemaase ola leshem ola, pesula. asaah lemala kemaase chullam, pesula:
7.2: Olat haof sheasaah lemala, kemaase ola leshem ola, keshera, kemaase ola leshem chattat, keshera, uvilvad shello alta labbealim. kemaase chattat leshem ola, kemaase chattat leshem chattat, pesula. asaah lematta kemaase chullan, pesula:
7.3: Vechullan enan metammeot bevet habbelia, umoalin bahen, chutz mechattat haof sheasaah lematta, kemaase chattat leshem chattat:
7.4: Olat haof sheasaah lematta, kemaase chattat leshem chattat, rabbi eliezer omer, moalin bah. rabbi yehoshua omer, en moalin bah. amar rabbi eliezer, ma im chattat, sheen moalin bah lishmah, kesheshshinna et shemah, moalin bah, ola, shemmoalin bah lishmah, kesheshshinna et shemah, eno din sheyyimalu vah. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, lo, im amarta vechattat sheshshinna et shemah leshem ola shekken shinna et shemah ledavar sheyyesh bo meila, tomar beola sheshshinna et shemah leshem chattat, shekken shinna et shemah ledavar sheen bo meila. amar lo rabbi eliezer, vahare kadshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom ushechatan leshem kadashim kallim yochichu, shekken shinna et sheman ledavar sheen bo meila, umoalin bahen, af atta al titma al haola, sheaf al pi sheshshinna et shemah ledavar sheen bo meila, sheyyimalu vah. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, lo, im amarta vekadshe kadashim, sheshchatan baddarom ushechatan leshem kadashim kallim, shekken shinna et sheman bedavar sheyyesh bo issur vehetter, tomar beola sheshshinna et shemah bedavar shekkullo hetter:
7.5: Malak bismol, o vallayla, shachat chullin bifnim, vekadashim bachutz, enan metammein bevet habbelia. malak besakkin, malak chullin bifnim, vekadashim bachutz, torin shello higgia zemannan, uvene yona sheavar zemannan, sheyyavash gappa, veshennismet enah, veshenniktea raglah, metamme vevet habbelia. ze hakkelal, kol shehaya fesulah bakkodesh, enah metammea vevet habbelia. lo haya fesulah bakkodesh, metammea vevet habbelia. vechol happesulim shemmalku, melikatan pesula, veenan metammeot bevet habbelia:
7.6: Malak venimtza terefa, rabbi meir omer, enah metammea vevet habbelia. rabbi yehuda omer, metammea vevet habbelia. amar rabbi meir, ma im nivlat behema, shehi metammea vemagga uvemassa, shechitatah metaheret et terefatah mittumatah, nivlat haof sheenah metammea vemagga uvemassa, eno din shettehe shechitatah metaheret et terefatah mittumatah. ma matzinu vishchitatah, shehi machshartah baachila, umetaheret et terefatah mittumatah, af melikatah, shehi machshartah baachila, tetaher et terefatah mittumatah. rabbi yose omer, dayyah kenivlat behema, shechitatah metahartah, aval lo melikatah:

8.1: Kol hazzevachim shennitarvu vechattaot hammetot, o veshor hanniskal, afillu echad beribbo, yamutu chullam. nitarvu veshor shenneevda vo avera, o shehemit et haadam al pi ed echad, o al pi habbealim, berovea, uvenirba, uvemuktze, uveneevad, uveetnan, uvimchir, uvechilayim, uvitrefa, uveyotze dofen, yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru veyavi vidme hayyafe shebbahen meoto hammin. nitarev bechullin temimim, yimmachru hachullin litzriche oto hammin:
8.2: Kadashim bekadashim min bemino, ze yikrav leshem mi shehu veze yikrav leshem mi shehu. kadashim bekadashim, min besheeno mino, yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyavi vidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze, uvidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze, veyafsid hammotar mibbeto. nitarvu vivchor uvemaaser, yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyeachlu kivchor uchemaaser. hakkol yecholin lehitarev, chutz min hachattat umin haasham:
8.3: Asham shennitarev bishlamim, yiru ad sheyyistaavu. rabbi shimon omer, shenehem yishshachatu vatztzafon, veyeachlu chechamur shebbahen. amru lo, en meviin kadashim levet happesul. nitarvu chatichot bachatichot, kadshe kadashim bekadashim kallim, hanneechalin leyom echad banneechalim lishne yamim, yeachlu chechamur shebbahen:
8.4: Evre chattat shennitarvu veevre ola, rabbi eliezer omer, yitten lemalan, veroe ani et besar hachattat milmalan keillu hu etzim. vachachamim omrim, teubbar tzuratan veyetze levet hasserefa:
8.5: Evarin beevre vaale mumin, rabbi eliezer omer, im karev rosh achad mehen, yikrevu chol harashin. karo shel achad mehen, yikrevu chol hakkeraayim. vachachamim omrim, afillu karvu chullam chutz meachad mehen, yetze levet hasserefa:
8.6: Dam shennitarev bemayim, im yesh bo mare dam, kasher. nitarev beyayin, roin oto cheillu hu mayim. nitarev bedam behema o vedam chayya, roin oto cheillu hu mayim. rabbi yehuda omer, en dam mevattel dam:
8.7: Nitarev bedam pesulin, yishshafech laamma. bedam tamtzit, yishshafech laamma. rabbi eliezer machshir. im lo nimlach venatan, kasher:
8.8: Dam temimim bedam baale mumim, yishshafech laamma. kos bechosot, rabbi eliezer omer, karav kos echad, yikrevu chol hakkosot. vachachamim omrim, afillu karvu chullam chutz meachad mehen, yishshafech laamma:
8.9: Hannittanin lematta shennitarvu vannittanin lemala, rabbi eliezer omer, yitten lemala, veroe ani et hattachtonim lemala keillu hen mayim, veyachazor veyitten lematta. vachachamim omrim, yishshafchu laamma. veim lo nimlach venatan, kasher:
8.10: Hannittanin mattana achat shennitarvu vannittanin bemattana achat, yinnatnu mattana echat. mattan arba bemattan arba, yinnatnu bemattan arba. mattan arba bemattana achat, rabbi eliezer omer, yinnatnu vemattan arba. rabbi yehoshua omer, yinnatnu vemattana echat. amar lo rabbi eliezer, vahare hu over al bal tigra. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, vahare hu over al bal tosif. amar lo rabbi eliezer, lo neemar bal tosif ella cheshehu veatzmo. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, lo neemar bal tigra ella cheshehu veatzmo. veod amar rabbi yehoshua, keshennatatta, avarta al bal tosif veasita maase veyadecha. ucheshello natatta, avarta al bal tigra velo asita maase veyadecha:
8.11: Hannittanin bifnim shennitarvu im hannittanin bachutz, yishshafchu laamma. natan bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim, kasher. bifnim vechazar venatan bachutz, rabbi akiva fosel, vachachamim machshirim. shehaya rabbi akiva omer, kol haddamim shennichnesu lechapper bahechol, pesulin. vachachamim omrim, chattat bilvad. rabbi eliezer omer, af haasham, shenneemar (Vayikra 7) kachattat kaasham:
8.12: Chattat shekkibbel damah bishne chosot, yatza achad mehen lachutz, happenimi kasher. nichnas achad mehen lifnim, rabbi yose haggelili machshir bachitzon, vachachamim poslin. amar rabbi yose haggelili, ma im bemakom shehammachashava foselet, bachutz, lo asa et hameshoar kayotze, mekom sheen hammachashava foselet, bifnim, eno din shello naase et hameshoar kannichnas. nichnas lechapper, af al pi shello chipper, pasul, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi shimon omer, ad sheyyechapper. rabbi yehuda omer, im hichnis shogeg, kasher. kol haddamim happesulin shennittenu al gabbe hammizbeach, lo hirtza hatztzitz ella al hattame, shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame, veeno meratztze al hayyotze:

9.1: Hammizbeach mekaddesh et harauy lo. rabbi yehoshua omer, kol harauy laishshim, im ala lo yered, shenneemar (Vayikra 6), hiv haola al mokda al hammizbeach. ma ola shehi reuya laishshim, im alta lo tered, af kol davar shehu rauy laishshim, im ala lo yered. rabban gamliel omer, kol harauy lammizbeach, im ala lo yered, shenneemar, hiv haola al mokda al hammizbeach. ma ola shehi reuya lammizbeach im alta lo tered, af kol davar shehu rauy lammizbeach im ala lo yered. en ben divre rabban gamliel ledivre rabbi yehoshua ella haddam vehannesachim, sherabban gamliel omer lo yerdu, verabbi yehoshua omer yeredu. rabbi shimon omer, hazzevach kasher vehannesachim pesulim, hannesachim kesherin vehazzevach pasul, afillu ze vaze pesulin, hazzevach lo yered, vehannesachim yeredu:
9.2: Veellu im alu, lo yerdu. hallan, vehattame, vehayyotze, vehannishchat chutz lizmanno, vechutz limkomo, veshekkibbelu fesulim, vezarku et damo. rabbi yehuda omer, shennishchata vallayla, veshennishpach damah, vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim, im alta, tered. rabbi shimon omer, lo tered, shehaya rabbi shimon omer, kol sheppesulo vakkodesh, hakkodesh mekabbelo. lo haya fesulo vakkodesh, en hakkodesh mekabbelo:
9.3: Ellu lo haya fesulan bakkodesh, harovea, vehannirba, vehammuktze, vehanneevad, vehaetnan, vehammechir, vehakkilayim, vehatterefa, vehayyotze dofen, uvaale mumin. rabbi akiva machshir bevaale mumin. rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, doche haya abba et baale mumin meal gabbe hammizbeach:
9.4: Keshem sheim alu lo yerdu, kach im yardu lo yaalu. vechullan shealu chayyim lerosh hammizbeach, yeredu. ola shealta chayya lerosh hammizbeach, tered. shechatah berosh hammizbeach, yafshit vinattach bimkomah:
9.5: Veellu im alu yerdu, besar kadshe kadashim, uvesar kadashim kallim, umotar haomer, ushete hallechem, velechem happanim, usheyare menachot, vehakketoret. hatztzemer shebberashe chevasim, vehassear shebbizkan teyashim, vehaatzamot, vehaggidim, vehakkarnayim, vehattelafayim, bizman shehen mechubbarin, yaalu, shenneemar (Vayikra 1), vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha. parshu, lo yaalu, shenneemar (Devarim 12), veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam:
9.6: Vechullam sheppaku meal gabbe hammizbeach, lo yachazir. vechen gachelet sheppaka meal gabbe hammizbeach. evarim sheppaku meal gabbe hammizbeach, kodem lachatzot, yachazir, umoalin bahen. leachar chatzot, lo yachazir, veen moalin bahen:
9.7: Keshem shehammizbeach mekaddesh et harauy lo kach hakkevesh mekaddesh. keshem shehammizbeach vehakkevesh mekaddeshin et harauy lahen, kach hakkelim mekaddeshim. kele hallach mekaddeshin et hallach, umiddot hayyavesh mekaddeshot et hayyavesh. en kele hallach mekaddeshim et hayyavesh, velo middot hayyavesh mekaddeshot et hallach. kele hakkodesh shennikkevu, im osim hem meen melachtan shehayu osin vehem shelemim, mekaddeshin. veim lav, en mekaddeshim. vechullan en mekaddeshim ella vakkodesh:

10.1: Kol hattadir mechavero, kodem et chavero. hattemidim kodmim lammusafin, musefe shabbat kodmin lemusefe rosh chodesh, musefe rosh chodesh kodmin lemusefe rosh hashshana, shenneemar (Bamidbar 28), millevad olat habboker asher leolat hattamid taasu et elle:
10.2: Vechol hamekuddash mechavero, kodem et chavero. dam chattat kodem ledam ola, mippene shehu meratztze. evre ola kodmin leemure chattat, mippene shehen kalil laishshim. chattat kodemet leasham, mippene sheddamah nittan al arba keranot veal hayyesod. asham kodem letoda uleel nazir, mippene shehu kadshe kadashim. hattoda veel nazir kodmin lishlamim, mippene shehen neechalin leyom echad, uteunim lachem. shelamim kodmin livchor, mippene shehem teunin mattan arba, usemicha unnesachim utenufat chaze vashok:
10.3: Habbechor kodem lammaaser mippene shekkedushshato merechem, veneechol lakkohanim. hammaaser kodem laofot, mippene shehu zevach veyesh bo kadshe kadashim, damo veemurav:
10.4: Haofot kodmin lammenachot, mippene shehen mine damim. minchat chote kodemet leminchat nedava, mippene shehi vaa al chet. chattat haof kodemet leolat haof. vechen behekdeshah:
10.5: Kol hachattaot shebbattora, kodmot laashamot, chutz measham metzora, mippene shehu va al yede hechsher. kol haashamot shebbattora bain bene shetayim uvain bechesef shekalim, chutz measham nazir vaasham metzora, shehen bain bene shenatan veenan bain bechesef shekalim:
10.6: Keshem shehen kodmim behakeravatan, kach hen kodmim baachilatan. shelamim shel emesh ushelamim shel hayyom, shel emesh kodmin. shelamim shel emesh vechattat veasham shel hayyom, shelamim shel emesh kodmin, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hachattat kodemet, mippene shehi kadshe kadashim:
10.7: Uvechullam, hakkohanim rashshain leshannot baachilatan, leachlan tzeluyim, shelukim, umevushshalim, velatet letochan tivle chullin vetivle teruma, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi meir omer, lo yitten letochan tivle teruma, shello yavi et hatteruma lide fesul:
10.8: Amar rabbi shimon, im raita shemen shehu mitchallek baazara, en atta tzarich lishol ma hu, ella motar rekike minchot yisrael, velog shemen shel metzora. im raita shemen shehu natun al gabbe haishshim, en atta tzarich lishol ma hu, ella motar rekike minchot kohanim, uminchat kohen hammashiach. sheen mitnaddevim shamen. rabbi tarfon omer, mitnaddevim shamen:

11.1: Dam chattat shennittaz al habbeged, hare ze taun kibbus. af al pi sheen hakkatuv medabber ella vanneechalot, shenneemar (Vayikra 6), bemakom kadosh teachel, echad hanneechelet veechad happenimit teunot kibbus, shenneemar (sham), torat hachattat, tora achat lechol hachattaot:
11.2: Chattat pesula en damah taun kibbus, ben shehaya lah sheat hakkosher, ben shello haya lah sheat hakkosher. ezo hi shehaya lah sheat hakkosher. shellana, shennitmea, vesheyyatza. veezo hi shello haya lah sheat hakkosher. shennishchata chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah, veshekkibbelu fesulin vezarku et dama:
11.3: Nittaz min hatztzavvar al habbeged, eno taun kibbus. min hakkeren umin hayesod, eno taun kibbus. nishpach al haritzpa vaasafo, eno taun kibbus. en taun kibbus ella haddam shennitkabbel bichli verauy lehazzaya. nittaz al haor ad shello hufshat, eno taun kibbus. mishshehufshat, taun kibbus, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi eliezer omer, af mishshehufshat eno taun kibbus. eno taun kibbus ella mekom haddam, vedavar shehu rauy lekabbel tuma, verauy lechibbus:
11.4: Echad habbeged veechad hassak veechad haor, teunin kibbus bemakom kadosh. ushevirat keli cheres, bemakom kadosh. umerika ushetifa bichli nechoshet, bemakom kadosh. ze chomer bachattat mikkadshe kadashim:
11.5: Beged sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim, nichnas umechabbeso vemakom kadosh. nitma chutz lakkelaim, koro, venichnas umechabbeso vemakom kadosh. keli cheres sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim, nichnas veshovro vemakom kadosh. nitma chutz lakkelaim, nokvo, venichnas veshovro vemakom kadosh:
11.6: Keli nechoshet sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim, nichnas umorko veshotfo vemakom kadosh. nitma chutz lakkelaim, pochato, venichnas umorko veshotfo vemakom kadosh:
11.7: Echad shebbishshel bo veechad sheera letocho roteach, echad kadshe kadashim veechad kadashim kallim, teunin merika ushetifa. rabbi shimon omer, kadashim kallim enan teunin merika ushetifa. rabbi tarfon omer, im bishshel bo mittechillat haregel, yevashshel bo et kol haragel. vachachamim omrim, ad zeman achila. merika ushetifa, merika kimrikat hakkos, ushetifa kishtifat hakkos. merika bechammin ushetifa betztzonen. vehashshappud vehaaskela magilan bechammin:
11.8: Bishshel bo kadashim vechullin, o kadshe kadashim vekadashim kallim, im yesh bahen benoten taam, hare hakkallim neechalin kachamurin, veenan teunin merika ushetifa, veenam poslin bemagga. rakik shennaga berakik, vachaticha bachaticha, lo chol harakik velo chol hachatichot asurin. eno asur ella mekom shebbala:

12.1: Tevul yom umechussar kippurim, enan cholkim bakkodashim leechol laarev. onen, nogea veeno makriv, veeno cholek leechol laarev. baale mumin, ben baale mumin kevuin, ben baale mumin ovrin, cholkin veochlin, aval lo makrivin. vechol sheeno rauy laavoda, eno cholek babbasar. vechol sheen lo babbasar, en lo vaorot. afillu tame vishat zerikat damim vetahor bishat hekter chalavim, eno cholek babbasar, shenneemar (Vayikra 7), hammakriv et dam hashshelamim veet hachelev mibbene aharon lo tihye shok hayyamin lemana:
12.2: Kol shello zacha hammizbeach bivsarah, lo zachu hakkohanim beorah, shenneemar (sham), olat ish, ola shealta leish. ola shennishchata shello lishmah, af al pi shello alta labbealim, orah lakkohanim. echad olat haish veechad olat haishsha, orotehen lakkohanim:
12.3: Orot kadashim kallim labbealim, veorot kadshe kadashim lakkohanim. kal vachomer, ma im ola, shello zachu vivsarah, zachu veorah, kadshe kadashim, shezzachu vivsarah, eno din sheyyizku veorah. en mizbeach yochiach, sheen lo or mikkol makom:
12.4: Kol hakkodashim sheera bahem pesul kodem lehefshetan, en orotehem lakkohanim. leachar hefshetan, orotehem lakkohanim. amar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim, miyyamay lo raiti or yotze levet hasserefa. amar rabbi akiva, middevarav lamadnu, shehammafshit et habbechor venimtza terefa, sheyyeotu hakkohanim beoro. vachachamim omrim, en lo rainu reaya, ella yotze levet hasserefa:
12.5: Parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim, bizman shehem nisrafin kemitzvatan, nisrafin bevet haddeshen umetammein begadim. veim enan nisrafin kemitzvatan, nisrafin bevet habbira veenam metammein begadim:
12.6: Hayu sovlin otam bemotot. yatzu harishonim chutz lechomat haazara vehaacharonim lo yatzu, harishonim metammein begadim, vehaacharonim enan metammein begadim, ad sheyyetzeu. yatzu ellu vaellu, ellu vaellu metammein begadim. rabbi shimon omer, ellu vaellu enan metammein begadim, ad sheyyitztzat haur berubban. nittach habbasar, en hassoref metamme vegadim:

13.1: Hashshochet vehammaale vachutz, chayyav al hashshechita vechayyav al haaliyya. rabbi yose haggelili omer, shachat bifnim veheela vachutz, chayyav. shachat bachutz veheela vachutz, patur, shello heela vachutz ella davar pasul. amru lo, af hashshochet bifnim umaale vachutz, kevan shehotzio, pesalo:
13.2: Tame sheachal, ben kodesh tame uven kodesh tahor, chayyav. rabbi yose haggelili omer, tame sheachal tahor, chayyav. vetame sheachal tame, patur, shello achal ella davar tame. amru lo, af tame sheachal tahor, kevan shennaga bo, timmeahu. vetahor sheachal tame, patur, sheeno chayyav ella al tumat hagguf:
13.3: Chomer bashshechita mibbaaliyya, uvaaliyya mibbashshechita. chomer bashshechita, shehashshochet lehedyot, chayyav, vehammaale lehedyot, patur. chomer baaliyya, shenayim sheachazu vesakkin veshachatu, peturim. achazu veevar veheeluhu, chayyavin. heela, vechazar veheela, vechazar veheela, chayyav al kol aliyya vaaliyya, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yose omer, eno chayyav ella achat, veeno chayyav ad sheyyaale lerosh hammizbeach. rabbi shimon omer, afillu heela al hassela o al haeven, chayyav:
13.4: Echad kadashim kesherin veechad kadashim pesulin shehaya fesulan bakkodesh, vehikrivan bachutz, chayyav. hammaale chazzayit min haola umin haemurin bachutz, chayyav. hakkometz, vehallevona, vehakketoret, uminchat kohanim, uminchat kohen hammashiach, uminchat nesachin, shehikriv meachad mehen kazayit bachutz, chayyav. rabbi elazar poter, ad sheyyakriv et kullo. vechullam shehikrivan bifnim veshiyyer bahen kazzayit vehikrivan bachutz, chayyav. vechullam shechasru chol shehen, vehikrivan bachutz, patur:
13.5: Hammakriv kadashim veemurehem bachutz, chayyav. mincha shello nikmetza vehikrivah bachutz, patur. kematzah, vechazar kumtzah letochah, vehikrivah bachutz, chayyav:
13.6: Hakkometz vehallevona, shehikriv et achad mehen bachutz, chayyav. rabbi elazar poter ad sheyyakriv et hashsheni. echad bifnim veechad bachutz, chayyav. shene veziche levona, shehikriv et achad mehen bachutz, chayyav. rabbi elazar poter, ad sheyyakriv et hashsheni. echad bifnim veechad bachutz, chayyav. hazzorek miktzat damim bachutz, chayyav. rabbi elazar omer, af hamenassech me chag bechag bachutz, chayyav. rabbi nechemya omer, sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz, chayyav:
13.7: Hammolek et haof bifnim veheela vachutz, chayyav. malak bachutz veheela vachutz, patur. hashshochet et haof bifnim veheela vachutz, patur. shachat bachutz veheela vachutz, chayyav. nimtza, derech hechshero mibbifnim, peturo vachutz. derech hechshero vachutz, peturo vifnim. rabbi shimon omer, kol shechayyavin alav vachutz, chayyavin al kayyotze vo vifnim, sheheelahu vachutz, chutz min hashshochet bifnim umaale vachutz:
13.8: Hachattat shekkibbel damah bechos echad, natan bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim, bifnim vechazar venatan bachutz, chayyav, shekkullo rauy lavo vifnim. kibbel damah bishne chosot, natan shenehem bifnim, patur. shenehen bachutz, chayyav. echad bifnim veechad bachutz, patur. echad bachutz veechad bifnim, chayyav al hachitzon, vehappenimi mechapper. lema haddavar dome, lemafrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha veachar kach nimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen omdot. shachat shetehen bifnim, patur. shachat shetehen bachutz, chayyav. achat bifnim veachat bachutz, patur. achat bachutz veachat bifnim, chayyav al hachitzona, vehappenimit mechapperet. keshem sheddamah poter et besarah, kach hu foter et besar chavertah:

14.1: Parat chattat shesserafah chutz miggittah, vechen sair hammishtalleach shehikrivo vachutz, patur, shenneemar (Vayikra 17), veel petach ohel moed lo hevio. kol sheeno rauy lavo el petach ohel moed, en chayyavin alav:
14.2: Harovea, vehannirba, vehammuktze, vehanneevad, vehaetnan, vehammechir, vehakkilayim, vehatterefa, veyotze dofen, shehikrivan bachutz, patur, shenneemar (Vayikra 17), lifne mishkan Adonai, kol sheeno rauy lavo lifne mishkan Adonai, en chayyavin alav. baale mumin, ben baale mumin kevuim, ben baale mumin ovrim, shehikrivan bachutz, patur. rabbi shimon omer, baale mumin kevuim, patur, uvaale mumin ovrin, ovrin belo taase. torim shello higgia zemannan uvene yona sheavar zemannan, shehikrivan bachutz, patur. rabbi shimon omer, bene yona sheavar zemannan, patur. vetorim shello higgia zemannan, belo taase. oto veet beno umechussar zeman, patur. rabbi shimon omer, hare ze velo taase. shehaya rabbi shimon omer, kol shehu rauy lavo leachar zeman, hare ze velo taase veen bo charet. vachachamim omrim, kol sheen bo charet, en bo velo taase:
14.3: Mechussar zeman, ben begufo ben bivalav. eze hu mechussar zeman bivalav. hazzav, vehazzava, veyoledet, umetzora, shehikrivu chattatam vaashamam bachutz, peturin. olotehen veshalmehen bachutz, chayyavin. hammaale mibbesar chattat, mibbesar asham, mibbesar kadshe kadashim, mibbesar kadashim kallim, umotar haomer, ushete hallechem, velechem happanim, usheyare menachot, hayyotzek, habbolel, happotet, hammoleach, hammenif, hammaggish, hamesadder et hashshulchan, vehammetiv et hannerot, vehakkometz, vehamekabbel damim bachutz, patur. en chayyavin alav lo mishshum zarut, velo mishshum tuma, velo mishshum mechussar begadim, velo mishshum rechutz yadayim veraglayim:
14.4: Ad shello hukam hammishkan, hayu habbamot muttarot, vaavoda babbechorot. mishshehukam hammishkan, neesru habbamot, vaavoda bakkohanim. kadshe kadashim, neechalim lifnim min hakkelaim. kadashim kallim, bechol machane yisrael:
14.5: Bau laggilgal, vehutteru habbamot. kadshe kadashim, neechalim lifnim min hakkelaim. kadashim kallim, bechol makom:
14.6: Bau leshilo, neesru habbamot. lo haya sham tikra, ella vayit shel avanim millemattan viriot milmalan, vehi hayta menucha. kadshe kadashim neechalim lifnim min hakkelaim, kadashim kallim umaaser sheni, bechol haroe:
14.7: Bau lenov ulegivon, hutteru habbamot. kadshe kadashim neechalim lifnim min hakkelaim. kadashim kallim, bechol are yisrael:
14.8: Bau lirushalayim, neesru habbamot, velo haya lahem od hetter, vehi hayta nachala. kadshe kadashim, neechalim lifnim min hakkelaim, kadashim kallim umaaser sheni, lifnim min hachoma:
14.9: Kol hakkodashim shehikdishan bishat issur bamot, vehikrivan bishat issur bamot bachutz, hare ellu vaase velo taase, vechayyavin alehen karet. hikdishan bishat hetter bamot, vehikrivan bishat issur bamot, hare ellu vaase velo taase, veen chayyavin alehen karet. hikdishan bishat issur bamot vehikrivan bishat hetter bamot, hare ellu vaase veen bahem belo taase:
14.10: Ellu kadashim kerevim bammishkan. kadashim shehukdeshu lammishkan, karbenot hatztzibbur, kerevin bammishkan. vekarbenot hayyachid, bevama. karbenot hayyachid shehukdeshu lammishkan, yikrevu vammishkan. veim hikrivan bevama, patur. ma ben bamat yachid levamat tzibbur, semicha, ushechitat tzafon, umattan saviv, utenufa, vehaggasha. rabbi yehuda omer, en mincha vevama. vechihun, uvigde sharet, uchele sharet, vereach nichoach, umechitztza vaddamim, urechutz yadayim veraglayim. aval hazzeman, vehannotar, vehattame, shavim baze uvaze:
